$comment: Every v1 asset slug. This file exists BEFORE any image does — engineering builds against these slugs while every one of them resolves to a placeholder. Swapping a placeholder for final art is a registry row change, never a code change. See ASSET_PIPELINE.md.

interaction.$comment: Per PROJECT_SPEC/18_PARLOR_NAVIGATION_MAP.md v2.0 (Counter Shop and Back Hall). Every room object is exactly one role. Every Door glows ONLY when it has something meaningful to say, and nothing that is not a Door ever glows — the fixed 'exactly three glow' rule of v1.0 is withdrawn. Objects without a role are scenery and are not interactive.

roles.door: Navigates. Glows only when it has something to say.
roles.door_locked: Visible and tappable, NEVER glows. Answers with a Tony line, not a route.
roles.display: Shows live content in place. Never glows — the content is the affordance.
roles.scenery: Not interactive. The default, and most of the room.

silhouettes.$comment: ALPHA-DERIVED. Glow is filter: drop-shadow() applied to the overlay's OWN alpha channel, so it follows the silhouette exactly, never covers the wall beside the object, and updates automatically when the art is swapped. The authored-SVG-polygon requirement of v1.0 is withdrawn: no authored masks, no polygons, no hit-map images, and 'needsSilhouette' is no longer a field.
silhouettes.derivation: filter: drop-shadow() on the overlay's own alpha
silhouettes.minimumTouchTarget: 44px effective — expand the hit region, never the glow
silhouettes.reducedMotion: static outline instead of a pulse

object_champion_banner.$comment: One reusable pennant for every championship. Composited over zone_parlor_shell hanging from the shared rail at y 69, at x 56/78/100/122/144/166 -- reconciled 2026-07-29 so the row co-centres with the shifted board at 119.5 and sits wholly on the rod (x 54-184). Fills from the left, oldest first; completed seasons plus the current one, no future placeholders; six most recent on overflow. The two-digit year is rendered at runtime onto the red field; the asset carries no year, name, logo, emblem or glow. Canvas is 18x15 rather than 18x19: the source is 567x458 and the aspect is preserved. See art/B2_CHAMPION_BANNER.md.

_avatarLayers_B2.$comment: Free/starter layers available to every manager at claim time. Canvas raised from 32x48 to 64x96 in the character-customisation rebuild -- no art existed at the old size, every row was art_status placeholder, so the change cost nothing to re-cut. See lib/character/art/geometry.ts for the measurement it was chosen by. art_status placeholder means there is no PNG: these layers are drawn at runtime from lib/character/art/, and a PNG dropped in with a path takes over per layer without a code change.

Collectibles and wearables are separate product families — a pizza box awards collectible_*, character equipment uses wear_*. This comment previously claimed the opposite; that claim was wrong and contradicted the seeded reward table. Crossover rewards are not approved and must not be implemented without a later explicit ruling. Canvas raised to 64x96 alongside the free starter layers.
